common.milestone_pruning_rule: stop at epoch 2 if broken or collapsed; terminal comparison at epoch 5
common.fairness_note: Compare learned only with its frozen same-architecture control and compare one versus two FFNs only within the same router/expert family.

arms.hypothesis: One localized sparse FFN may preserve the pretrained backbone better than changing two adjacent FFNs.
arms.predicted_signature: One FFN improves learned-over-frozen mean and tail with route reliance above 0.01 and exceeds the matched two-FFN learned arm.
arms.alternative_explanation: Any gain comes from less architectural disruption rather than useful routing.
arms.falsifier: Frozen matches learned, the two-FFN arm matches it, the tail falls, or reliance stays below 0.01.
arms.fairness_class: same E2 sparse total within learned/frozen; one-versus-two FFN depth estimand labeled separately

arms.hypothesis: The one-FFN frozen control isolates learned mixture weights from the reduced-disruption architecture.
arms.predicted_signature: Learned exceeds frozen only if the router adapts usefully.
arms.alternative_explanation: Reduced surgery or fixed smoothing explains the outcome.
arms.fairness_class: same E2 sparse total and top-2 active compute

arms.hypothesis: Coherent image routing may work when restricted to one measured high-conflict FFN, avoiding excessive backbone disruption.
arms.predicted_signature: Learned exceeds frozen and the matched two-FFN image arm on mean and tail with reliance above 0.01.
arms.alternative_explanation: Reduced surgery or fixed image partitions explain any improvement.
arms.falsifier: Frozen matches learned, the two-FFN arm matches it, the tail falls, or reliance stays below 0.01.
arms.fairness_class: same E16 sparse total within learned/frozen; one-versus-two FFN depth estimand labeled separately
